bull.claim: +77.6% YoY revenue and +92.3% PAT growth in Q2 FY27.
bull.why: Accelerating revenue expansion translates directly into bottom-line profitability and operational scale.

bull.claim: 3.1% EBITDA margin in Q2 FY27, expanded +1.4 pp YoY.
bull.why: Operating leverage strengthens core profitability and operational efficiency as scale increases.

bull.claim: 21% QoQ volume growth delivered in Q1FY27.
bull.why: Customer order momentum expands market footprint and strengthens underlying delivery volume throughput.

bull.claim: 12 days net working capital and 14 days inventory in Q1FY27.
bull.why: Efficient inventory turnover minimizes working capital requirements and preserves balance-sheet liquidity.

bear.claim: −₹936 cr cumulative PAT over FY22–FY26 reflects persistent net losses.
bear.why: Protracted historical losses deplete equity capital and demonstrate absence of cash generation.

bear.claim: 0.15 debt/equity at FY26 end, increased from 0.00 at FY22 end.
bear.why: Rising debt levels introduce interest burdens and elevate balance-sheet solvency risk.

bear.claim: Down about 6% QoQ store throughput in Q3FY26.
bear.why: Lower store-level productivity reduces return on invested capital and weakens network economics.

bear.claim: Market share loss despite lower customer fees under intense competition in Q1 FY27.
bear.why: Fee discounting without market share retention damages unit economics and operating margins.
